'''Paul Todd Feldman Feldman's Light Side Deck''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Paul Todd Feldman]]
* '''Published:''' August 1997 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Dagobah]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Dagobah: Yoda's Hut|Dagobah-L-dagobahyodashut.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Feldman's Light Side Deck
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDag Feldman's Light Side Deck Feldman L.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Squadron member Kyle Heuer (Red 7), tournament director of the Star Wars Customizable Card Game Open event at San Diego Comic Con, sent Open winner Paul Feldman's Light Side deck our way with this comment:

<blockquote>
"This is perhaps the best Light Side deck I have ever seen! It controls the flow of the game so well that it would be hard for anyone to get a victory off this deck that hasn't built a deck to beat it!" Well? What do you think?
</blockquote>
